unreviewed_scope: A: Complete Mat/UMat/SparseMat lifecycle, allocation, strides, reshape, external views, all public typed access specifications and fixed helpers; root value-type equivalence
B: All arithmetic depth/channel/N-D/mask/output modes; bitwise, LUT, reductions, channel routing, borders, sorting, concatenation and destination mode matrices
C: invert/solve decomposition flags, least squares, eigen/eigenNonSymmetric, SVD/backSubst/solveZ, PCA/LDA, covariance modes, polynomial solvers and optim.hpp solver callbacks
D: Full DFT/DCT scaling/nonzeroRows/row-wise/CCS modes, CCS conversion and destination alias proof
E: RNG/RNG_MT19937/distribution/shuffle modes, kmeans, covariance, PSNR, checkRange/patchNaNs and special-value tests
F: All 32 sparse typed layouts, stored traversal invalidation, conversion tables, native arithmetic surface and extrema lifetime/error tests
G: Complete FileStorage/FileNode methods, formats/encoding/raw persistence, typed values, sequence/map error and lifetime tests
H: CPU reporting, error redirection/break-on-error, global state, parallel execution, logging, filesystem and command-line utilities
I: Vec/Matx/Complex/Point/Rect/Size/RotatedRect/Range/TermCriteria, Algorithm/Ptr, affine and quaternion overload semantics, softfloat and new OpenCV 5 types
J: ocl.hpp/cuda.hpp/OpenGL/DirectX/VA interfaces, bufferpool/allocator support, async ownership, accelerator exclusions and CPU fallback qualification
Discovery closure: inspect additional public Core headers and assign every discovered in-scope capability; representative-name extraction is not exhaustive parsing
